newsitem.title: USA: Life USA broker/dealer unit gets approval.
newsitem.headline: Life USA broker/dealer unit gets approval.

text.p: Life USA Holding Inc said its newly formed broker/dealer subsidiary, LifeUSA Securities Inc, received approval from the National Association of Securities Dealers to begin wholesale operations.

LifeUSA Securities initially will offer a family of proprietary funds established through a joint-venture agreement with Investment Advisers Inc, a $16 billion asset management firm based in Minneapolis.
The LifeUSA funds will offer investors a range of investment options. Life USA also is exploring development of variable annuities and variable life insurance.
Life USA Holding is a financial services holding company.
